title: Old Landmarks in Egypt and London
text:
The Pyramids are in Egypt. They are very old. They are made of big stones. Many tourists take photos of them.

Big Ben is in London. It is a famous clock. It has a loud bell. Many people like to see it at night.

questions.text: Why do many tourists take photos of the Pyramids?
options: Because the Pyramids are very beautiful and old
Because the Pyramids are in a shop

questions.text: What can we guess about Big Ben?
options: It is a very popular place for visitors

vocabulary.definition: small or large pieces of rock

paragraph_translations: Piramitler Mısır'dadır. Çok eskidirler. Büyük taşlardan yapılmışlardır. Birçok turist onların fotoğraflarını çeker.
Big Ben Londra'dadır. Ünlü bir saattir. Yüksek sesli bir çanı vardır. Birçok insan geceleri onu görmeyi sever.
